$comment: The DECLARED task universe. Read scripts/lib/task-dirs.js (checkTaskUniverse) before editing.
why: Markdown2Html and PublishKbArticle migrated in from azure-pipelines-terraform (Phase 3 of the shared-task-core initiative), and Changelog is the release-engineering half this extension is named for (Phase 2). All three must exist for a gate run over Tasks/ to mean anything, so the floor is 3 rather than 0: a run that enumerates fewer has lost task code, not found a clean repository. Raise this as further tasks land.
